payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for tuning a per-word reward using the perceptron algorithm, detailing its effectiveness and sensitivity to various factors.

claims.text: A per-word reward can be tuned using a perceptron-like method, which is a quick post-training step.
The optimal value of the per-word reward is sensitive to task and beam size, necessitating tuning for each model.
Tuning the word reward generally leads to improvements in translation quality metrics like BLEU and METEOR.
